answer: Problem: bounty boards flood when one operator spins dozens of near-clone wallets. Mechanism: each new wallet publishes a short-lived cipher commitment that unlocks only after attesting three unrelated lotus-tagged tasks in a quiet zephyr window of low peer density, blocking burst unlocks. Cost: about two quiet hours plus three unpaid attests before first payout. Verification: peers recompute unlock from the commitment and three task hashes; mismatch freezes the wallet. Failure: if the quiet window is shorter than rotate time, clones still unlock together.
